ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (2/4 quarters filed (2025-09-30, 2025-12-31) — a lower bound) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buyback_yield.note: a lower bound — a positive leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

notes: quarterly DPS (declared): 3 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2010-03-31: 0.4 (filed 2010-05-06) used, not 0.2 (filed 2011-05-05) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2010-06-30: 0.4 (filed 2010-07-30) used, not 0.2 (filed 2011-08-02) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2010-09-30: 0.4 (filed 2010-10-27) used, not 0.2 (filed 2011-11-01) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 3.57 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.9525, 2026-06-30: 0.9525) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.8925, 2025-06-30: 0.8925)
